verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Fenwick Labs builds internal tools including 'automated generation of incorporation documents' and 'online term-sheet generation,' but these are described as tools built for existing clients/practices, not free public generators available without being a client. The public-facing Startup Resource Center offers articles, videos, checklists and presentations — not downloadable SAFEs, incorporation documents, or NDAs. No evidence confirms free, non-client access to actual legal document generators or templates.
